# Sources independent of the RTL: patent US 4,325,121 (App. H, by page), manual (MC68000UM par. 6, exception processing; M68000PRM par. 4, STOP), measurements against the reference core with comparison benches made during development, not part of this repository (available from the author on request: diff-fuzz-si per instruction family, lockstep-si, reset), per-instruction testbenches of sim/Makefile.si (make -f Makefile.si <name>).

# The four added words are OUR OWN, at addresses where the die has no word (docs/data/mc68000_micro_decoded.csv: no address in 3f0-3ff): the source is the specification in their rows and in docs/microcode-structure.md section 3 (Contents of the core's micro ROM); 3fc and 3fd are exercised by a measurement (CONFIRMED), 3fe and 3ff are in the micro ROM but no path of the core reaches them (IMPLEMENTATION CHOICE, not observable; 3fe has the 17 bits of the die word trap1, 1d0: see their rows).

column4: CONFIRMED (repair): in the die dump (docs/data/mc68000_micro_decoded.csv, row 1c8) the word is all zero (hole in the dump: among the 26 all-zero words of the CSV it is the only one that is not zzz); App. H p139 "rstp2 -> rstp3": next address 002, format I, FC 0; measurement: reset testbench (comparison bench, case reset: vector sequence and first fetch equal to the reference) and lockstep-si (the reset reaches the first fetch)

CONFIRMED (our own word): STOP wait, companion of 3fd: format I, I=1 (samples the request at its end, as 3fd: the reference core latches it at every word, measured on five wake-ups), TY=0 (next 3fd), FC 0, empty nanoword; the loop 3fc, 3fd gives the four-clock period of the die's loop 327, 3a2 (micro decoded csv: 3a2 stop1 next 327, 327 TY=1); measured against the reference core (comparison bench ssext7, case stop_ref: the wake-up on the same 16-tick grid); raw17 from the physical NMA layout (A0..A9 <- raw bits 11, 12, 7, 8, 9, 10, 5, 6, 13, 14, verified on the die rows)

CONFIRMED (our own word): STOP wait, format I, I=1, TY=1 (A1 dispatch: to 3fc while stopped, the loop 3fc, 3fd of two words with the four-clock period of the die's loop 327, 3a2; the interrupt is taken at this dispatch, measured against the reference core: same instants); word of our own design: the bit specification is this entry; function in docs/microcode-structure.md section 3 (3fd: STOP wait, A1 dispatch on wake-up); M68000PRM par. 4, STOP; measurement: per-instruction testbench stop (make -f Makefile.si stop) and diff-fuzz-si family IRQ (interrupt that wakes up the STOP)

IMPLEMENTATION CHOICE (our own word, not reached): written to the micro ROM by gen_urom.py with these bits (tb_m68k_ustore checks the ROM against this entry), but no path of the core reaches it: its only predecessor is 3ff, itself unreachable, and the instruction exceptions enter at 0e3 (rtl/cpu_si/m68k_exc_si.sv, A_TRAP = 0e3: dvur2, the divide-by-zero path of the die); docs/data/mc68000_nrom_reach.tsv lists 3fe and 3ff as used but unreachable. Content: format I, NMA = 347 (trap2); the bit specification is this entry. Comparison with the die: the die has no word at 3fe (docs/data/mc68000_micro_decoded.csv: no address in 3f0-3ff; App. H has no block at 3fe); these 17 bits are those of the die word trap1 (docs/data/mc68000_micro_decoded.csv row 1d0: the A1 entry of TRAP #n, docs/data/mc68000_a123_die.tsv opcodes 4e40-4e4f), copied by gen_urom.py; the nanoword at 3fe is our own (docs/data/deviations/nstore.tsv row 3fe)

IMPLEMENTATION CHOICE (our own word, not reached): written to the micro ROM by gen_urom.py with these bits (tb_m68k_ustore checks the ROM against this entry), but no path of the core reaches it: no word has 3ff as next address, and the A1 value 3ff of the illegal opcodes never dispatches because the exception block overrides it with a0 = A_TRAP = 0e3 (rtl/cpu_si/m68k_exc_si.sv; docs/data/scripts/nrom_reach.py); docs/data/mc68000_nrom_reach.tsv lists it as used but unreachable. Content: format I, NMA = 3fe; the bit specification is this entry. Comparison with the die: the die has no word at 3ff (docs/data/mc68000_micro_decoded.csv: no address in 3f0-3ff; in the die PLA 3ff is the value "none", header of docs/data/mc68000_a123_die.tsv) and no die word has these bits or NMA 3fe; the nanoword at 3ff is our own (docs/data/deviations/nstore.tsv row 3ff)
